def is_transitive(n, m, friendships):
    # Create an adjacency list representation of the graph
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for a, b in friendships:
        graph[a].append(b)
        graph[b].append(a)
    
    # Check the transitive property for all triplets of members
    for x in range(1, n + 1):
        for y in graph[x]:
            for z in graph[y]:
                if z not in graph[x]:
                    return "NO"
    
    return "YES"
